BiblicalUsage: Kesheph means magic, sorcery, witchcraft: 2 Kings 9:22 has Jehu asking, what peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? Isaiah 47:9 says loss of children and widowhood shall come upon Babylon for the multitude of thy sorceries. Micah 5:12 promises, I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand. Nahum 3:4 calls Nineveh the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sorcery is never a small thing: it sells nations, it crowns harlots, and it brings the loss of children in one day. I hold that God cuts it off with his own hand, and I want no part of what he cuts off.
